Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back (or step them back one at a time) into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump up and clap above or behind the head
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - мяч у груди, м:
Starting position: ball at the chest; you may start already in the squat
From the squat, with the hips below the knees, stand up by extending the legs hard and throw the ball at the target
Generate most of the throwing power with the legs
Once the ball hits the target, catch it and drop back into a full squat
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - ноги на ширине:
Starting position: feet hip-width apart, dumbbells on the floor outside the legs
Take the dumbbells by the handles and lower the hips as far as your mobility allows, keeping the feet flat on the floor
Head, upper and lower back in neutral
Build pre-tension: shoulder blades back and down, back tight, legs ready to drive
Drive the feet into the floor and bring the hips forward, reaching upwards with the crown of the head
Finish the movement with knee, hip and shoulder joints in one vertical line
Avoid excessive arching at the top
The negative phase starts with the hips moving back
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Starting position: feet hip-width apart, kettlebells on the floor outside the legs
Take the kettlebells by the handles and lower the hips, keeping the feet flat on the floor
Head, upper and lower back in neutral
Build pre-tension: shoulder blades back and down, back tight, legs ready to drive
Drive the feet into the floor and bring the hips forward, reaching upwards with the crown of the head
Finish the movement with knee, hip and shoulder joints in one vertical line
Avoid excessive arching at the top
The negative phase starts with the hips moving back
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Starting position: feet hip-width apart, the bar on the floor against or close to the shins
Take a snatch grip on the bar — you should know or work out your width in advance — lower the hips and keep the feet flat on the floor
Head, upper and lower back in neutral
Build pre-tension: shoulder blades back and down, back tight, legs ready to drive
Drive the feet into the floor and bring the hips forward, reaching upwards with the crown of the head
Finish the movement with knee, hip and shoulder joints in one vertical line
Avoid excessive arching at the top
The negative phase starts with the hips moving back
Start bending the knees once the bar has passed them
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Attach the band to the bar and stand on it
Take a snatch grip on the bar — you should know or work out your width in advance — lower the hips and keep the feet flat on the floor
Back in neutral: head, upper and lower back
Build pre-tension: shoulder blades back and down, back tight, legs ready to drive
Drive the feet into the floor and bring the hips forward, reaching upwards with the crown of the head
Finish the movement with knee, hip and shoulder joints in one vertical line
Avoid excessive arching at the top

Start bending the knees once the bar has passed them
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя\nОпускаем:
Starting position: standing
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart and kick both legs back, or step them back one at a time, into a plank
Jump the knees in towards the chest
Once the feet are back under you, jump up and clap above or behind the head
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Starting position: standing
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back, or step them back one at a time, into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump forward as far as you can
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя боком к ш:
Starting position: standing side-on to the bar
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back (or step them back one at a time) into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump sideways over the bar off both legs; step closer to the bar first if you need to
You land in the starting position, but on the other side of the bar
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя лицом к б:
Starting position: standing facing the box
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back (or step them back one at a time) into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump onto the box with both feet
After landing on the box, straighten the legs fully at the knees and hips
Step back off the box, one foot then the other, into the starting position
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Starting position: standing facing the box; a side-on variation also exists
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back (or step them back one at a time) into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump onto the box with both feet; you can turn slightly as you land and step back down backwards
Step off the far side of the box, one foot then the other
Turn to face the box again, back to the starting position
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя лицом к ш:
Starting position: standing facing the bar
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart,
kick both legs back, or step them back one at a time, into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump over the bar off both legs; step closer to the bar first if you need to
After landing, turn to face the bar again into the starting position, or turn slightly as you jump
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя под перек:
Starting position: standing under the bar
Put the hands on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back (or step them back one at a time) into a plank and touch the floor with the chest
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or by stepping in one leg at a time
Once the feet are back under you, jump up and grab the bar
Hanging from the bar, pull the chest towards it with the eyes forward
At the top the chin is above the bar
Lower under control until the arms are fully straight
Drop back down into the starting position under the bar
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя с гантель:
Starting position: standing with a dumbbell in one hand
Put the dumbbell on the floor, brace the other hand on the ground about shoulder-width away, kick both legs back or step them back one at a time into a plank, and touch the floor with the chest between the hands
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or one leg at a time, landing on the whole foot, back straight
Drive the feet into the ground and stand up with the dumbbell until the knees and hips are fully extended
Then snatch the dumbbell overhead, explosively and mainly with the legs and back
Lock the weight out overhead with the elbow and shoulder fully extended
Lower the dumbbell to the starting position and repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя с гантеля:
Starting position: standing with dumbbells in hand
Put the dumbbells on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back, or step them back one at a time, into a plank and touch the floor with the chest between the dumbbells
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or one leg at a time, landing on the whole foot, back straight
Drive the feet into the ground and stand up with the dumbbells until the knees and hips are fully extended
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

Starting position: standing with dumbbells in hand
Put the dumbbells on the floor about shoulder-width apart, kick both legs back, or step them back one at a time, into a plank and touch the floor with the chest between the dumbbells
Press up until the elbows are fully extended
Bring the knees to the chest with a jump or one leg at a time, landing on the whole foot, back straight
Drive the feet into the ground and stand up with the dumbbells until the knees and hips are fully extended
Then snatch the dumbbells overhead, explosively and mainly with the legs and back
Lock the weights out overhead with the elbows and shoulders fully extended
Lower the dumbbells to the starting position and repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение - стоя у стены д:
Starting position: standing at the wall with the ball at the chest
Drop into a full squat with the hips below the knees, then stand up by extending the legs hard and throw the ball up at the target or above the mark on the wall
Generate most of the throwing power with the legs
Once the ball hits the wall, catch it and drop back into a full squat
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение «упор лёжа»\nПре:
Starting position: plank
Abs braced, legs in line with the torso
As you start, try to draw the belly towards the spine
Bend the legs in turn, drawing each knee towards the opposite side of the chest
The pelvis tucks naturally as the leg comes in
desc:Исходное положение лёжа на спине, р:
Starting position: lying on the back, hands behind the head, knees bent
Start by contracting the abs, drawing the belly towards the spine
Extend one leg while drawing the other towards the opposite shoulder, alternating sides
As the knee comes towards the shoulder, reach past it with the opposite elbow

The thighs are locked firmly under the pads
Torso leans slightly forward, abs braced

desc:Исходное положение:\nВстаем ногами:

Stand on the band with the feet roughly shoulder-width apart

Stand upright
Feet roughly hip-width apart
Arms along the body
Movement:

Come up out of the lunge, driving the knee towards the chest
Once the required number of reps is done, switch legs

Stand upright with a slight forward lean
Hold a support for balance
Anchor the band low on a power rack or something solid

Keep the hips stable throughout

desc:Исходное положение:\nГолова в верти:
Starting position:
Head upright, eyes forward, chin close to the chest
Feet roughly shoulder-width apart
Shin perpendicular to the floor

Lower as deep as you can, keeping firm contact under the bottom of the shoulder blades

desc:Исходное положение:\nГолова и верх:

Head and upper back on the floor
Arms extended along the body, pressing into the floor
Abs and glutes braced, the lower back and hips off the floor

desc:Исходное положение:\nГолова и спина:

Back pressed firmly into the machine's backrest
Feet roughly shoulder-width apart, set high on the platform

desc:Исходное положение:\nГриф расположе:

Hold the torso and legs off the floor
Hold the medicine ball and the legs at chest level
Rotate the torso and the ball to one side
Then to the other
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps

The torso leans forward by flexing at the hips
Hips pushed back, shins perpendicular to the floor
Head and back in neutral
Focus during the movement:

desc:Исходное положение:\nКорпус слегка:

Torso leans slightly forward, hips pushed back
Head and back in neutral
Weight spread evenly across the whole foot
Lower to roughly 90 degrees at the knees
On the way up: drive the feet down
Unrack the bar and lock it by turning the handle
desc:Исходное положение:\nЛожимся на спи:
Starting position:
Lie on your back
Arms extended along the body
Knees bent to 90 degrees
Movement:
Lower the right arm and left leg towards the floor, keeping the pelvis neutral
Return to the starting position under control
Repeat with the left arm and right leg

Lie on your back with the knees bent
Hold the weight at the chest with both hands

Return to the starting position under control
desc:Исходное положение:\nЛёжа на спине,:

Lying on the back with the knees bent and the feet on the floor
The ball or bottle held on straight arms over the chest
Movement:
Slowly lower the straight arms behind the head, keeping the lower back on the floor
Without touching the floor, bring the arms back to the starting position

Starting position:
Lying on the back with one knee bent and that foot on the floor, the other leg raised
Movement:
Lift the hips by squeezing the glutes, keeping the raised leg straight
Do the required number of reps on one side, then switch
No movement in the lower back

Lying on the back, arms along the body or under the hips, legs straight
Movement:

The lower back stays on the floor throughout

Lying on the back, hands behind the head, knees bent
Movement:
Lift the shoulders while drawing one knee towards the chest
Reach the opposite elbow towards that knee

desc:Исходное положение:\nМаксимально ра:

Wrists in neutral

During the eccentric phase:

desc:Исходное положение:\nНейтральное по:

Spine in neutral
On the way down: as you squat, push the hips as far back as you can and let the knee bend naturally
Weight spread evenly across the whole foot
Lower to roughly 90 degrees at the knees
On the way up: drive the feet down and extend at the hips, pushing them forward
Avoid pushing the hips forward at the top of the range

Hold the machine's frame for balance
On the way down: bend the knee and the hip at the same time
Weight spread evenly across the whole foot
On the way up: drive the feet into the floor, extending the knees and hips

Hold the machine's frame or the bar for balance
On the way down: bend the knee and push the hips back at the same time
Weight spread evenly across the whole foot
On the way up: drive the feet into the floor, extending the knees and hips

On the way down: bend the knee and push the hips back at the same time
Weight spread evenly across the whole foot

desc:Исходное положение:\nНоги +/- на ши:

Continue until fully flexed or until the bar touches the floor
The hips shift back a little to keep balance
On the way up:
Extend in reverse order, starting from the lower segments of the spine
Controlled tempo through the whole range, no jerky movement
desc:Исходное положение:\nНоги и корпус:

Hold the legs and torso off the floor with the medicine ball on the floor to one side
Pick up the ball, rotate the torso and the ball to one side and touch it to the floor
Then to the other side, touching the floor again
Repeat the whole movement for the required number of reps
desc:Исходное положение:\nНоги на ширине:

Feet hip-width apart
The rear toes line up with the front heel
Hold the bar in the hand opposite the front leg
Hold the machine's frame with the other hand for stability
Head and back in neutral
Weight on the whole front foot with the emphasis on the heel

On the way up:

desc:Исходное положение:\nОграничитель р:

Feet a short distance from the wall

Flex the spine under control, starting from the upper segments
Continue until fully flexed
On the way up:

Controlled tempo through the whole range, no jerky movement

move the pelvis away from the ribcage under control and extend the legs

Head and back stay neutral throughout the set

desc:Исходное положение:\nРегулируем тре:

Rest the stomach on the machine's pad
Hold the frame with straight arms for stability
Abs braced, without over-arching the lower back
Movement:
Pull the knee creases back and up
desc:Исходное положение:\nРуки вытянуты:

The arms are extended forward at chest height
The elbows stay fixed throughout the set
Movement:
Start by contracting the abs, drawing the belly towards the spine
Rotate the torso diagonally from low to high
The arms and the cable move in one plane
desc:Исходное положение:\nСадимся в трен:
Starting position:
